statistic: Each variant: plain 1 warmup + 6 measured rounds; then diagnostic 1 warmup + 3 measured rounds. Cyclic candidate order; plain final three rounds reverse the cyclic order.
scope: Elapsed callback/dispatch time includes vCPU descheduling. Worker tail intervals run from callback completion to dispatch return; they are not measured worker WFI. Only main-core WFI is timed. MatMul and output-copy dispatches are separate; waits overlap other cores' work.

analysis.decision: Keep 8 blocks. 4-block median improves in this batch but only wins 4 of 6 paired rounds, with the direction reversing between first and last three rounds.
analysis.interpretation: Tail intervals overlap work on other cores. Main-core WFI is measured separately. Diagnostic and plain batches differ in time and generated code; their timing difference is not a causal instrumentation cost. No original 1x4 baseline was run in this batch.
analysis.independent_retest_conclusion: Keep claim8. Claim4 median is 2.47% slower in this independent batch despite winning 5 of 8 pairs. The two batches do not establish a stable claim4 advantage; this also does not establish stable regression.
